about: tools/bgs/campus.json -- the campus record (docs/UI2_DESIGN.md 5.2, K4, D14). The only place an outdoor fact is written.
`fixed` rows are facts a picture the owner chose shows; each names that picture and its revision in `by`.
`proposed` rows are the plan's words for what is not painted yet: they go into prompts, and change without ceremony when a chosen picture says otherwise.
`waived` rows name a fixed fact, the chosen picture that stands against it and the date the owner accepted that; only tools/install_redo.py --waive writes one.
`pictures` are the pictures the owner has chosen; `waits` are things a new picture must put right that no tool can see.

tools/check_campus.py checks it, tools/campus_plan.py draws it and writes CAMPUS2.md from it (which also explains every key), and tools/make_scene_workflow.py builds every outdoor and map prompt from it.
No row a prompt reads (`as`, `look`, `court_side`, `words`, `shows`) names the series or a character.
